declared_before_any_result: committed and pushed before any B-rep of the whole body was built in this attempt; the result record must cite this file's commit and show a build time after it. Nothing here may be changed after a result: a different rule needs a new file and a new attempt
earlier_attempt: T2 (2026-11-06, README 'T2 editable B-rep: measured negative result'): band-stack prisms fused with OCCT, invalid, 13 solids on a 10 mm slab

validity.brepcheck: BRepCheck_Analyzer on the whole shape written to STEP, geometric checks on, reports IsValid() true
validity.one_solid: the shape holds exactly one TopoDS_Solid and no face, shell or solid outside it; enclosed voids may be inner shells of that solid
validity.closed: ShapeAnalysis_FreeBounds finds no free edge in the solid
validity.volume: BRepGProp volume positive and within 0.5% of the reference body's volume (a consistency check, not an accuracy claim)
validity.step_round_trip: the STEP file read back with STEPControl_Reader gives one solid with the same face count that passes the same BRepCheck
validity.not_a_triangle_copy: at most 10% of the B-rep's area may lie in faces that are single triangles of the reference body; the face count by surface type is reported

scorecard.checker: source/score_twin.py unchanged, on a tessellation of the B-rep written to STL
scorecard.tessellation: BRepMesh_IncrementalMesh with an absolute linear deflection of at most 0.01 mm and an angular deflection of at most 0.1 rad; the values used are recorded
scorecard.control: the reference body is re-scored in the same environment first. If it reproduces scorecard-v2-loft-s025.json within 0.0005 in every share and 0.001 mm in every percentile, the committed reference numbers are used; otherwise both bodies are compared on the re-scored numbers and the difference is reported
scorecard.oracle: the checker's trimesh oracle must pass on the B-rep tessellation
scorecard.why_these_values: 0.5 point within 0.2 mm is a quarter of what separates the v2 body from the T1 reference surface (97.4% against 99.5%); 0.01 mm on p95 is the size of the checker's single-precision loss on needle triangles. Better than the reference is not a requirement

differing_regions.distances: every non-hardware scan facet measured to the B-rep tessellation and to the reference body with score_twin.py's own Warp kernel, in one run; delta = distance to the B-rep minus distance to the reference
differing_regions.by_class: share within 0.2 mm of both bodies by zone and surface class (the classes of error_breakdown.py), and the change in points of the whole scan area
differing_regions.clusters: scan facets whose delta exceeds 0.05 mm in magnitude or whose 0.2 mm verdict changes, joined by single linkage at 2 mm on facet centroids; every cluster of at least 1 mm2 is listed, largest first, at most 30 rows, with centroid and extent rounded to 1 mm, zone, area, mean and largest delta and the net change of area within 0.2 mm; totals of all clusters are given
differing_regions.body_to_body: B-rep tessellation against the reference surface both ways: area-weighted p50, p99 and largest distance, and the B-rep area farther than 0.01 and 0.05 mm from the reference by face type

inferred_closure.rule: every face carries one class: observed when at least half of its tessellated area lies within 0.2 mm of the bare scan (the scorecard's support threshold), inferred_closure otherwise. The class is written into the STEP as a face name and the display colour of hypotheses.json
inferred_closure.reported: face counts and areas by class, and the area whose triangle-level class differs from its face's class
inferred_closure.standing: the class says where the scanner saw the surface; it retires no hypothesis (H01, H02, H04 stay as registered)

outcome: accepted only if every validity item, every tolerance and the oracle hold. Otherwise the attempt is recorded as a measured negative result naming each item that failed and its measured value, and the failed attempts stay in the record
limits: acceptance compares the B-rep with the scan and with the reference body only; it says nothing about unobserved geometry, physical calibration or function, and the B-rep's own checks never certify it
